annotations.title: Path Length and Illegal Character Check

description: Check Windows file and folder paths before copying, syncing or unzipping files. Send up to 100 paths; get back per path the length (in the UTF-16 units Windows counts) against the 260 MAX_PATH limit (259 characters for a file, 247 for a folder, about 32,767 with long paths or \\?\), names over 255 characters, illegal characters (< > : " | ? * and control characters), reserved names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9, also with an extension like NUL.txt) and names ending in a space or a period, each by part number. Paths are not echoed back. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/path-length-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

kind.description: file (default; limit 259) or folder (limit 247, room left for an 8.3 file name inside it).

long_paths_enabled.description: true when the target machine has long paths turned on (Windows 10 1607 or later, LongPathsEnabled set and the program opts in); the limit becomes about 32,767.

paths.description: The paths to check (up to 100), such as C:\Projects\2026\report.docx or \\server\share\folder\file.txt.
